reminder: Recall the definition of etale site before this proof.
definition: The small etale site of X has etale X-schemes as objects and jointly surjective etale families as covers.
examples: A finite separable field extension gives an object over a field.
Non-example: a purely inseparable nontrivial extension of fields is not an etale object.

reminder: Recall the definition of henselian local ring before this proof.
definition: A local ring is henselian when each factorization of a monic polynomial into coprime monic factors over its residue field lifts uniquely to monic factors over the ring.
examples: Every complete local ring is henselian.
Non-example: Z localized at 5 is not henselian, because a simple root of T^2+1 modulo 5 has no rational lift.
